==About==

{{i|Caterpillar}}s are commonly found in the wild, inside {{i|Myrtle Oak Tree}}s, when Dissecting {{i|Argopelter Gizzard}}s, or when Picking {{i|Honeysuckle Kudzu}}. Additionally, when Picking ripe {{i|Any Vegetable}}s which have sat for a day or two, you may occasionally find that a Caterpillar has eaten one of your Vegetables and taken its [[Purity]].
